milestones.title: ARPANET Pioneer Node Activated
milestones.fact: The first host-to-host message was transmitted across ARPANET between UCLA and Stanford, establishing the foundation of the modern Internet.

milestones.title: Linus Torvalds Announces Linux Kernel
milestones.fact: Linus Torvalds released the initial Linux kernel 0.01, creating the open-source operating system that now powers the majority of global cloud servers.

milestones.title: Steve Jobs Unveils the Original iPhone
milestones.fact: Apple announced the iPhone, combining a widescreen iPod, a revolutionary mobile phone, and a breakthrough internet communicator into a single multitouch device.

milestones.title: OpenAI Launches ChatGPT
milestones.fact: OpenAI launched ChatGPT, sparking the generative AI revolution and making large language models accessible to hundreds of millions worldwide.
